title: UPME: An Unsupervised Peer Review Framework for Multimodal Large Language Model Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing an unsupervised evaluation framework for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) specifically targeting visual understanding, reasoning capabilities, and technical bias mitigation (such as verbosity and self-preference). It does not contain any evaluation or benchmarking related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
